scripts.title: BLACKLIST/WHITELIST BY MEY
scripts.script:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TextChatService = game:GetService("TextChatService")

local blacklisted = {}
local whitelisted = {}

local function sendChatMessage(message)
    pcall(function()
        local channels = TextChatService:WaitForChild("TextChannels")
        local general = channels:WaitForChild("RBXGeneral")
        general:SendAsync(message)
    end)
end

local function findPlayer(partialName)
    local search = partialName:lower()

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Name:lower():sub(1, #search) == search
            or player.DisplayName:lower():sub(1, #search) == search then
            return player
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function blacklistPlayer(searchName)
    local player = findPlayer(searchName)
    local key = searchName:lower()

    blacklisted[key] = true
    whitelisted[key] = nil

    if player then
        blacklisted[player.Name:lower()] = true
        blacklisted[player.DisplayName:lower()] = true

        sendChatMessage(player.Name .. " has been blacklisted.")

        sendChatMessage(";mute " .. player.Name)

        task.wait(0.5)

        sendChatMessage(";glitch " .. player.Name)
    else
        sendChatMessage(searchName .. " has been blacklisted.")
    end
end

local function whitelistPlayer(searchName)
    local player = findPlayer(searchName)
    local key = searchName:lower()

    whitelisted[key] = true
    blacklisted[key] = nil

    if player then
        whitelisted[player.Name:lower()] = true
        whitelisted[player.DisplayName:lower()] = true

        blacklisted[player.Name:lower()] = nil
        blacklisted[player.DisplayName:lower()] = nil

        sendChatMessage(player.Name .. " has been whitelisted.")
        sendChatMessage(";Enlighten " .. player.Name)
    else
        sendChatMessage(searchName .. " has been whitelisted.")
    end
end

sendChatMessage("Blacklist whitelist script loaded credits to me_meymeyme Use !whitelist username Or !blacklist username")

TextChatService.MessageReceived:Connect(function(message)
    local text = message.Text

    if text:sub(1, 11):lower() == "!blacklist " then
        local username = text:sub(12):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")

        if username ~= "" then
            blacklistPlayer(username)
        end

    elseif text:sub(1, 11):lower() == "!whitelist " then
        local username = text:sub(12):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")

        if username ~= "" then
            whitelistPlayer(username)
        end
    end
end)

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    task.wait(0.2)

    local username = player.Name:lower()
    local displayName = player.DisplayName:lower()

    if blacklisted[username] or blacklisted[displayName] then
        blacklisted[username] = true
        blacklisted[displayName] = true

        sendChatMessage(";mute " .. player.Name)

        task.wait(0.5)

        sendChatMessage(";glitch " .. player.Name)

    elseif whitelisted[username] or whitelisted[displayName] then
        whitelisted[username] = true
        whitelisted[displayName] = true

        sendChatMessage(";Enlighten " .. player.Name)
    end
end)

scripts.script:
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local humanoidRootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local cooldown = false
local immunityTag = "SallyRollImmunity"

screenGui.Name = "SallyRollGUI"

rollButton.BackgroundTransparency = 1
rollButton.Name = "RollButton"

rollButton.Image = "rbxassetid://5743593320"

local imageOff = "rbxassetid://5743593320"
local imageOn = "rbxassetid://5743593320"

local extraImage = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
extraImage.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 60)
extraImage.Position = UDim2.new(1, -201, 0.5, -22)
extraImage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
extraImage.Image = ""
extraImage.Parent = screenGui

local circle = Instance.new("Frame")
circle.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 60)
circle.Position = UDim2.new(0.86, -30, 0.88, -30)
circle.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

local cooldownImage = Instance.new("ImageLabel")

cooldownImage.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
cooldownImage.BackgroundTransparency = 1
cooldownImage.Image = ""
cooldownImage.Visible = false
cooldownImage.Parent = circle

local function startCooldown()
    cooldown = true
    cooldownImage.Visible = true
    rollButton.Image = imageOff
    circle.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
    wait(26)
    rollButton.Image = imageOff
    circle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    cooldownImage.Visible = false
    cooldown = false
end

local function activateRoll()
    if cooldown or not character or not humanoidRootPart then return end
    cooldown = true
    rollButton.Image = imageOn

    local animation = Instance.new("Animation")

    velocity2.Parent = humanoidRootPart

    local immuneTag = Instance.new("BoolValue")
    immuneTag.Name = immunityTag
    immuneTag.Parent = character
    Debris:AddItem(immuneTag, 1)

    wait(1)
    startCooldown()
end

        if frames[prevFrame] and prevFrame ~= currentFrame then

end

local function isEnemy(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return false end
    if LocalPlayer.Team and player.Team then
        if LocalPlayer.Team == player.Team then
            return false
        end
    end
    if player.TeamColor == LocalPlayer.TeamColor and LocalPlayer.TeamColor ~= BrickColor.new("White") then
        return false
    end
    return true
end

local function getNearestEnemy()
    local nearestTarget = nil
    local shortestDistance = math.huge
    local myCharacter = LocalPlayer.Character
    
    if not myCharacter or not myCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return nil end
    local myRoot = myCharacter.HumanoidRootPart

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if isEnemy(player) then
            local character = player.Character
            if character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                if character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                    local distance = (myRoot.Position - character.HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
                    if distance < shortestDistance then
                        shortestDistance = distance
                        nearestTarget = character
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return nearestTarget
end

local function hasBomb(character)
    local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if tool then
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local timePassed = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if not autoEnabled then return end
    
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not character or not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local rootPart = character.HumanoidRootPart
    
    if hasBomb(character) then
        local enemyChar = getNearestEnemy()
        if enemyChar and enemyChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and enemyChar:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
            local enemyRoot = enemyChar.HumanoidRootPart
            local enemyHumanoid = enemyChar.Humanoid
            
            humanoid:MoveTo(enemyRoot.Position)
            
            if enemyHumanoid:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping then
                humanoid.Jump = true
            end
            
            timePassed = timePassed + (dt * 4)
            local offsetAngle = math.sin(timePassed) * 0.9
            
            local lookAtTarget = CFrame.new(rootPart.Position, enemyRoot.Position)
            local rotatedCFrame = lookAtTarget * CFrame.Angles(0, offsetAngle, 0)
            rootPart.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame:Lerp(rotatedCFrame, dt * 8)
            
            local tool = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") or LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
            if tool then
                if tool.Parent == LocalPlayer.Backpack then
                    humanoid:EquipTool(tool)
                end
                pcall(function()
                    tool:Activate()
                end)
            end
        end
    end
end)

scripts.title: Fishy Hub | Full Money Farm, Auto Quest, Full Progresses +S
scripts.features:
This Fishy Hub script for Drive a Kukirin uses FishyUI and opens with RightShift, built around the game's own scooter remotes read from the place file. Its core is an auto rider that builds a navigation graph from Workspace.Roads by snapping each road model's bounding-box center to the surface and linking nearest neighbors, so the scooter follows actual tarmac instead of nosing into boundary walls. An obstacle-avoidance fan casts five rays across the front, biases steering away from blockers, eases off the throttle, and commits to a dodge side once most of the fan is blocked. Steering direction self-calibrates per chassis by watching whether the commanded input actually reduced heading error, since scooters disagree about which local axis is forward. The farm reads the six quest cards, classifies each by objective (distance, top speed, wheelie time, clean landings), rides whatever the nearest-to-done quest asks for, and claims rewards the moment progress reaches goal. Wheelies are driven on hold/rest cycles and tracked through the game's own ScooterPredictedWheelie attribute, with a built-in test that reports whether the front wheel actually lifted, while a progressive escape ladder reverses, tries the opposite steer, snaps back onto the nearest road node, and finally respawns the scooter if the rider stays wedged. Other tabs handle spawn and mount, dealership purchases, teleports to landmarks and players, finishes and paint via hex strings, parts, walk speed, noclip, infinite jump, horn, headlight, rainbow gamepass effects, and a code redemption queue that stops the instant the server locks the endpoint. Everything the hub changes is reverted on unload, including held keys, connections, and driving inputs.

Drive a kukirin, drive a kukirin!, driving a kukirin
